items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Bob Hammer in the context of a recording session ('Bob Hammer on piano'), but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of working together, or personal relationship.
